rulings.reason: Fourth stanza of Bessie's ballad ("poor orphan child"). The quoted song verses in this edition are carried verbatim, and 3.24, 3.25, 3.27 and 3.28 differ from the source only in straight quotes. Its inverted word order is ordinary for verse, and the blind reader paraphrased it correctly.

A verse of Rochester's song ("The truest love that ever heart"). Every stanza from 24.156 to 24.167 is verbatim apart from quote marks. The blind reader read "haunted as a robber-path" correctly from context.
A verse of the same song. The blind reader paraphrased it correctly, and "nigh" is clear from context.

A verse of the same song. The first blind reader flagged "Right, bar approach to me" as a risk but paraphrased it correctly. Two further paraphrase-only readers both identified Hate, Right and Might as the three actors, so no obstacle was demonstrated. Brontë's punctuation of the quoted poem is kept.

"In communion with the genius of the haunt": the first blind reader called it a moderate risk but understood it. Two paraphrase-only readers both resolved it as the spirit of the place, and the R2 accessibility review did not flag it. The genius-loci image is literary and effective, so no obstacle was demonstrated.
Plain and clear. The blind reader rated it CLEAR.

"Helpmeet" is St. John's deliberate scriptural register. 34.104 ("a missionary’s wife") glosses it at once, and the accepted text keeps the same word at 34.124 (post-cleanup 34.123), so changing it here would break that echo. The blind reader rated it CLEAR.
Clear: he lies down on "a swell of heath" (a heathery rise, called "the knoll" at 34.115). The blind reader rated it CLEAR.
Clear: Jane's refusal restated ("fellow-missionary, but not as your wife"). The blind reader rated it CLEAR.

"Very well" is Jane's elliptical answer to "How can we be forever together … and unwed?" Present-day readers hear it as assent. Two of three blind readers misread it, so the obstacle is demonstrated. The fix is to supply the elided predicate: "We can be together very well". See PATCH.json JE-TC-1.
